finalText:
**`Redis` died and took prod with it.**

Connection to `10.0.0.12:6379` dropped at `02:14:07` [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). Cache fell back to direct store reads. Then 173 timeouts and a cache miss storm. Queue depth climbed from 52 to 568. Max is 500. All 13 reconnect tries hit `ECONNREFUSED`. `worker-2` died of `JavaScript heap out of memory`. Supervisor killed `api` at `02:31:52`. The log ends there.

Next: find why `10.0.0.12:6379` refused every reconnect.
